title: Build-system compromise harvested coding-agent credentials from config paths
summary: A compromised build-system action explicitly targeted coding agents, harvesting stored API keys from configuration paths that are predictable by design. Patched releases shipped the same day. The first clear instance of a supply-chain actor treating agent credentials as the objective rather than a bonus — standardised config locations make one harvesting routine work across every install.

chain.BREACH: Malicious CI action executed in developer and CI environments.
chain.ESCALATE: Long-lived API keys recovered from agent config.
chain.HALT: Patched releases published; key rotation required.

sources.label: Cloud Security Alliance — AI agent prompt injection and CI/CD supply chain
